description: Enable or disable AI tracking and choose the mode. When enabled the camera follows the subject; disabling stops tracking. `mode` is either a human framing (normal | upper-body | close-up | headless | lower-body) or a standalone scene mode (group | whiteboard | desk | hand); scene modes imply enabled:true. After writing, the tool polls the status block until the mode settles and returns { verified, matched } — the aiMode the device actually landed on (matched:false means no subject was being tracked, so the mode could not take effect yet).
name: obsbot_ai_track
